name: Kindle-Bolt
description: The first thing every Sayer learns and the last thing most of them are good at: a spoken spark, thrown. Kindling is the loudest school because fire is the loudest thing a small voice can make.

name: Hush-Frost
description: Said under the breath, as Hush must be. The cold is not the point; the cold is what is left when the saying takes the noise out of a thing's blood and it forgets to be quick.

name: Mend
description: Mending does not close a wound. It reminds the body what shape it was in when it was last spoken of kindly, and the body, being vain, obliges.

name: Ward
description: A Binding said around yourself: a short sentence about where you end. For as long as it holds, the world argues with the sentence instead of with you.
